description: This file contains tests for the Parser class handling WindowManagerState trace data, verifying trace type, timestamp retrieval, and trace entry extraction.

classes.name: ParserWindowManagerDump
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the parser's handling of window manager dump trace data.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initializes the parser instance before all tests by loading the trace file.

methods.name: it('has expected trace type')
methods.description: Checks that the parser correctly reports the trace type as WINDOW_MANAGER.

methods.name: it('provides elapsed timestamp (always zero)')
methods.description: Verifies that the parser returns the expected elapsed timestamps, which are always zero.

methods.name: it('provides real timestamp (always zero)')
methods.description: Verifies that the parser returns the expected real timestamps, which are always zero.

methods.name: it('retrieves trace entry')
methods.description: Checks that the parser can retrieve a trace entry and verifies its timestamp.
